name: expand-url
title: Expand URL
description: Expand shortened URLs one hop at a time and copy any link in the redirect chain.
author: L_K_M

commands.name: expand-url
commands.title: Expand URL
commands.description: Expand a shortened URL and inspect every hop in its redirect chain.

commands.name: expand-clipboard-url
commands.title: Expand URL in Clipboard
commands.description: Expand the URL in the clipboard and inspect every hop in its redirect chain.

tools.name: expand-url
tools.title: Expand URL
tools.description: Expand a shortened or redirecting URL and report every hop in its redirect chain, the final destination, and any tracking parameters found along the way.

preferences.name: expansionMode
preferences.title: Expansion Mode
preferences.description: Full chain walks every redirect at once. Step by step issues exactly one request per keypress, so you can see where a link goes without following it.

preferences.name: autoExpandOnLaunch
preferences.title: Automatic Expansion
preferences.label: Expand as soon as a URL is available
preferences.description: Start expanding as soon as a URL arrives from the argument or clipboard. Turn off to never make a request without pressing Enter.

preferences.name: readClipboard
preferences.title: Clipboard
preferences.label: Prefill from the clipboard
preferences.description: Prefill the search bar when the clipboard contains a URL.

preferences.name: followMetaRefresh
preferences.title: Meta Refresh
preferences.label: Follow meta refresh redirects
preferences.description: Treat a short <meta http-equiv="refresh"> as a redirect. Requires downloading part of the page.

preferences.name: blockPrivateHosts
preferences.title: Private Hosts
preferences.label: Refuse private and loopback addresses
preferences.description: Refuse to follow redirects into your own network or to cloud metadata endpoints. Only turn this off if you are deliberately expanding internal URLs.

preferences.name: stripAggressively
preferences.title: Tracking Parameters
preferences.label: Also strip contextual parameters
preferences.description: Also treat ref, s, si, source and trk as tracking parameters. These sometimes carry meaning, so removing them can break a link.

preferences.name: userAgent
preferences.title: User Agent
preferences.description: Many shorteners reject unrecognised user agents. Raycast is the honest option; the browser options are the ones that work.

preferences.name: maxHops
preferences.title: Maximum Hops
preferences.description: Stop after this many hops. Between 1 and 100.

preferences.name: timeoutSeconds
preferences.title: Request Timeout
preferences.description: Seconds to wait for each hop. Between 1 and 120.

preferences.name: keepHistory
preferences.title: History
preferences.label: Remember recently expanded URLs
preferences.description: Keep a local list of the last 15 URLs you expanded, shown when the search bar is empty. Stored on this machine only.
